notes: Very thin market. Core Alem box: 0 rent, 1 sale (Alem Sana D, E-101 uch.4). No listings at all for Alem Zerde / Alem Dara (keyword 0/0 rent+sale; nothing on Kazybek bi above no.41 in any search). All 'nearby' rows sit in the NE corner of the wide box: the Space / Cosmic City / Turan House / Comfort Tandau cluster at Turan 89 x E-103 (~1.2-1.5 km NE of Alem) - this cluster also falls inside the ARNA wide box, so these rows appear in both alem.json and arna.json. Several rows print 'Есильский р-н' although E-103/Turan 89 is Nura (krisha district misprints) - kept. Probable duplicate pair: 1016516093 and 1012653935 (same 111.8 m2 / 72 mln, Space E-103 5a). Storage units (3.3-10 m2) inflate/deflate ppm - exclude for medians. 691031667 is basement (цоколь). Keyword-only rows (e.g. Kazybek bi 7/1-41 Dauir/Salman City, Алем keyword hits in Esil) were dropped as instructed because they are not in the ALEM area results.
